scope: protocol-side accrued rewards for Personal Onchain Companies and Defitea Fund

methodology.definition: Rewards already earned inside protocol contracts but not yet freely held in the company/fund wallet.
methodology.multiWallet: Defitea rewards are measured independently for defitea.eth and the Defitea Operations wallet, then aggregated into one Defitea Passport. Every reward retains wallet provenance.
methodology.aerodromeVelodrome: Aerodrome managed/Relay rewards are read directly. Defitea Velodrome additionally discovers veNFT ownership through official 40 Acres Optimism portfolio factories, then reads current rewards at the actual holder. Already distributed 40 Acres wallet payouts are not counted as accrued rewards.
methodology.curve: Base crvUSD FeeDistributor claims are simulated. Defitea VoteMarket veCRV incentives are tracked as a known pending supplement and are not guessed.
methodology.convex: Votium/The Union remains intentionally excluded until a reproducible member-level reward read is validated.
methodology.pendle: Per-wallet sPENDLE claimable merkle rewards and accrued ETH fees are read from Pendle official Core API. Legacy vePENDLE is normalized from vePendlePositionData for Passport display without adding it to TVL.
methodology.fx: Base veFXN FeeDistributor claims are simulated. VoteMarket veFXN incentives remain a known pending supplement.
methodology.yieldBasis: FeeDistributor.preview_claim is used; yb rewards are valued at current redemption value into underlying BTC assets.
methodology.frax: Fraxtal YieldDistributor.earned(account), with emitted reward token discovered onchain.
methodology.liquity: LQTYStaking pending ETH and LUSD gains.
methodology.resupply: GovStaker reward tokens are dynamically enumerated and earned(account, token) is read onchain.
methodology.tvlTreatment: Accrued Rewards remain separate from Company TVL and Treasury cash.
